Callout.Name: Cyclist on the Highway
Callout.Message: Cyclist riding on the highway, drivers reporting near misses.
Callout.Advisory: Single cyclist in a live lane, no lights.

Script.Line: I am allowed to be here. I have as much right as you do.
The drivers are the ones in the wrong, not me.
I am not getting in the back of a car. I will ride off at the next junction.

Lines.Approach: He is in a live lane with no lights on him. Somebody is going to hit him.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
